words: Scandinavian
/ˌskændɪˈneɪviən/ adjective. 斯堪的纳维亚的；北欧国家的（用于描述北欧地区的国家或文化）

phrases: in the public interest
为了公共利益；符合公众利益
The minister acted in the public interest.
部长为了公共利益行事。
evolve an excellent system
逐步形成一套优秀的体制
Sweden has evolved an excellent system for protecting citizens.
瑞典逐步形成了一套优秀的保护公民的体制。
protect the individual citizen
保护个人公民
The system protects the individual citizen from incompetent officials.
该体制保护个人公民免受不称职官员的侵害。
safeguard the interest of
保护...的利益；维护...的利益
The scheme was introduced to safeguard the interest of the individual.
该方案的出台是为了保护个人的利益。
be subject to
受...支配；受...影响；易遭受
The Ombudsman is not subject to political pressure.
巡视官不受政治压力的影响。
act on one's behalf
代表某人采取行动；代理
If a citizen's complaint is justified, the Ombudsman will act on his behalf.
如果公民的投诉是合理的，巡视官将代表他采取行动。
lodge a complaint
提出投诉；提起申诉
If any further complaints are lodged against him, he will be prosecuted.
如果再有人对他提出投诉，他将受到起诉。
put an end to
结束；终止；消灭
The Ombudsman's prompt action put an end to an unpleasant practice.
巡视官的迅速行动结束了一种不良做法。
deal roughly with
粗暴对待；虐待
A policeman had dealt roughly with foreigners on several occasions.
一名警察多次粗暴对待外国人。
be open to public inspection
公开接受公众检查；可供公众查阅
There is nothing secretive about the Ombudsman's work, for his correspondence is open to public inspection.
巡视官的工作没有任何秘密，因为他的信函可供公众查阅。

grammar.k: 现在完成时的被动语态 (Present Perfect Passive)
grammar.d: 现在完成时被动语态表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响，或动作持续到现在，且主语是动作的承受者。 用于描述某个动作或过程的结果，强调其对现在的影响。文中描述瑞典的体制被其他国家采用这一结果。
ex: The system has worked so well that it has been adopted in other countries too.
该体制运行良好，其他国家也采用了这一体制。
The Swedish Parliament introduced a scheme in 1809.
瑞典议会在1809年推出了一个方案。

grammar.k: 过去分词作定语 (Past Participle as Attribute)
grammar.f: 名词 + 过去分词 / 过去分词 + 名词
grammar.d: 过去分词作定语时，放在被修饰的名词之前或之后，表示被动和完成的意义。 用于简化定语从句，使句子更加简洁。常用于正式书面语中。
ex: A parliamentary committee representing all political parties appoints a person.
一个代表所有政党的议会委员会任命一人。
The official title of the person is 'Justiteombudsman'.
这个人的官方头衔是'司法特派员'。

grammar.f: so + 形容词/副词 + that + 结果状语从句
grammar.d: so后面接形容词或副词，that引导结果状语从句，表示'如此...以至于...'。 用于表达某种程度导致的结果。在文中说明瑞典体制运行良好以至于被其他国家采纳。
ex: The system has worked so well that it has been adopted in other countries too.
该体制运行良好，其他国家也采用了。
He is so busy that he cannot come.

patterns.p: The system has worked so well that...
o: The system has worked so well that it has been adopted in other countries too.
该体制运行良好，其他国家也采用了这一体制。
im: The policy has worked so well that it has become a model for other countries.
这项政策运行良好，已成为其他国家的典范。
The new teaching method has worked so well that it has been推广 in all schools.
新的教学方法效果良好，已在所有学校推广。

patterns.p: As long ago as + 年份, ... + 一般过去时
o: As long ago as 1809, the Swedish Parliament introduced a scheme to safeguard the interest of the individual.
早在1809年，瑞典议会就推出了保护个人利益的方案。
im: As long ago as 1990, China began its reform and opening-up policy.
早在1990年，中国就开始了改革开放政策。
As long ago as 1950, scientists discovered this phenomenon.
早在1950年，科学家们就发现了这一现象。

o: There is nothing secretive about the Ombudsman's work, for his correspondence is open to public inspection.
巡视官的工作没有任何秘密，因为他的信函可供公众查阅。
im: There is nothing secretive about the government's decision.
政府的这项决定没有任何秘密。
There is nothing secretive about our company's financial report.
我们公司的财务报告没有任何隐瞒。

patterns.p: The action he takes varies according to...
o: The action he takes varies according to the nature of the complaint.
他采取的行动因投诉的性质而异。
im: The punishment varies according to the seriousness of the crime.
惩罚的轻重取决于犯罪的严重程度。
The salary varies according to qualifications and experience.
工资根据资历和经验而有所不同。
